name: taskpilot
description: TaskPilot — a personal browser-automation control center: Chrome extension + local Playwright automation service with pluggable platform adapters.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,ext -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w automation-server" "npm run dev -w extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w automation-server && npm run build -w extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p automation-server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
